5namespace GuzzleHttp\Promise;
6
7/**
8 * A promise represents the eventual result of an asynchronous operation.
9 *
10 * The primary way of interacting with a promise is through its then method,
11 * which registers callbacks to receive either a promise’s eventual value or
12 * the reason why the promise cannot be fulfilled.
13 *
14 * @template TValue = mixed
15 * @template TReason = mixed
16 *
17 * @see https://promisesaplus.com/
18 */
19interface PromiseInterface
20{
21    public const PENDING = 'pending';
22    public const FULFILLED = 'fulfilled';
23    public const REJECTED = 'rejected';
24
25    /**
26     * Appends fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise, and returns
27     * a new promise resolving to the return value of the called handler.
28     *
29     * @template TFulfilledValue = never
30     * @template TFulfilledReason = never
31     * @template TRejectedValue = never
32     * @template TRejectedReason = never
33     *
34     * @param (callable(TValue): (TFulfilledValue|PromiseInterface<TFulfilledValue, TFulfilledReason>))|null $onFulfilled Invoked when the promise fulfills.
35     * @param (callable(TReason): (TRejectedValue|PromiseInterface<TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason>))|null   $onRejected  Invoked when the promise is rejected.
36     *
37     * @return PromiseInterface<($onFulfilled is null ? TValue : TFulfilledValue)|($onRejected is null ? never : TRejectedValue), ($onFulfilled is null ? never : TFulfilledReason|\Throwable)|($onRejected is null ? TReason : TRejectedReason|\Throwable)>
38     */
39    public function then(
40        ?callable $onFulfilled = null,
41        ?callable $onRejected = null
42    ): PromiseInterface;
43
44    /**
45     * Appends a rejection handler callback to the promise, and returns a new
46     * promise resolving to the return value of the callback if it is called,
47     * or to its original fulfillment value if the promise is instead
48     * fulfilled.
49     *
50     * @template TRejectedValue = never
51     * @template TRejectedReason = never
52     *
53     * @param callable(TReason): (TRejectedValue|PromiseInterface<TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason>) $onRejected Invoked when the promise is rejected.
54     *
55     * @return PromiseInterface<TValue|TRejectedValue, TRejectedReason|\Throwable>
56     */
57    public function otherwise(callable $onRejected): PromiseInterface;
58
59    /**
60     * Get the state of the promise ("pending", "rejected", or "fulfilled").
61     *
62     * The three states can be checked against the constants defined on
63     * PromiseInterface: PENDING, FULFILLED, and REJECTED.
64     *
65     * The state describes how this promise was settled, not the eventual
66     * outcome: a promise that was resolved with another promise, directly or
67     * by returning one from a then() handler, reports FULFILLED while the
68     * inner promise may still be pending, and wait() can still throw if the
69     * inner promise rejects. Poll the state only on promises settled with
70     * plain values, or call wait() first.
71     *
72     * @return self::PENDING|self::FULFILLED|self::REJECTED
73     *
74     * @see https://github.com/guzzle/promises/issues/101
75     */
76    public function getState(): string;
77
78    /**
79     * Resolve the promise with the given value, or with null if no value is given.
80     *
81     * @param TValue|PromiseInterface<TValue, TReason>|null $value
82     *
83     * @throws \LogicException if the promise is already settled with a
84     *                         conflicting resolution.
85     */
86    public function resolve($value = null): void;
87
88    /**
89     * Reject the promise with the given reason.
90     *
91     * @param TReason $reason
92     *
93     * @throws \LogicException if the promise is already settled with a
94     *                         conflicting resolution.
95     */
96    public function reject($reason): void;
97
98    /**
99     * Cancels the promise if possible.
100     *
101     * @see https://github.com/promises-aplus/cancellation-spec/issues/7
102     */
103    public function cancel(): void;
104
105    /**
106     * Waits until the promise completes if possible.
107     *
108     * Pass $unwrap as true to unwrap the result of the promise, either
109     * returning the resolved value or throwing the rejected exception.
110     *
111     * If the promise cannot be waited on, then the promise will be rejected.
112     *
113     * @return ($unwrap is true ? TValue : null)
114     *
115     * @throws \LogicException if the promise has no wait function or if the
116     *                         promise does not settle after waiting.
117     */
118    public function wait(bool $unwrap = true);
119}
